EB_COMP_STRONG.derivation: competition state variance reduced approximately by sqrt(2), corresponding to the exploratory signal from stronger competition shrinkage

EB_LOCAL.derivation: stationary log-SD approximately matches the frozen V2 Gamma-Poisson prior effective sample sizes at target-average count scale

EB_LOCAL_SLOW.derivation: slower local evolution because the exploratory half-life-shortening mechanism worsened both targets

challenger_architecture.central_intensity_for_stage1: posterior median exp(log-location); latent variance is not collapsed into a Poisson mean
challenger_architecture.same_kickoff_contract: frozen priors and forecasts before batch-aggregated updates
challenger_architecture.state_space: Gaussian log-intensity assumed-density filter with Poisson likelihood and Laplace posterior update
challenger_architecture.uncertainty: posterior variance retained separately for later distributional integration

evaluation.selection_rule: Within each target choose the candidate with lowest pooled DEVELOPMENT primary metric only if it also wins primary metric in at least 3 of 4 chronological folds and does not worsen pooled fixed-line binary log loss by more than 0.001 versus reference. Otherwise no Stage1 candidate advances.
evaluation.ties: If pooled primary metrics differ by <=0.0005, choose lower-complexity order EB_COMP_STRONG < EB_LOCAL < EB_LOCAL_SLOW.
evaluation.uncertainty_interpretation: latent expected-rate intervals are state-estimation uncertainty diagnostics only; predictive count uncertainty is deferred to a separately frozen distributional stage

evidence_motivating_new_version.diagnostic_signal: NO_TEAM_GLOBAL_TRANSFER ranked first for goals and corners composite; this motivates a new version but is not promotion evidence

next_stage: Only a Stage1-advancing target may enter a separately preregistered distribution/calibration Stage2.
purpose: Test a competition-local uncertainty-aware log-rate state-space estimator after V1 rejected cross-competition team-global residual transfer.
